name: Governed Memory
description: Adds trust governance to agent memory: injection-scores content on write, keeps untrusted/quarantined memory out of the prompt, and blocks tool calls backed by poisoned memory.

apiUrl.description: Governed Memory REST API base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8000

apiKey.description: Bearer API key (resolves to your tenant server-side; never sent in the request body)

customerId.description: Subject/customer id to scope this agent's memories under

inboundSourceType.description: Provenance source_type applied to inbound messages (untrusted by default, since they come from external channels)

sensitiveTools.description: Tool names to gate. A call to one of these is blocked when the current turn is injection-flagged / quarantined. web_fetch is included by default because a poisoned turn's 'fetch <url>' is a data-exfiltration vector.

injectionThreshold.description: Injection score at/above which a memory marks the session as poisoned (blocks sensitive tools).
